scenario.description: A battalion S-3 operations officer must publish the staffing roster for a three-desk logistics coordination cell supporting a four-day field exercise. The roster must assign qualified personnel to the partner-liaison, POL-accountability, and movement-control desks, record the qualification details supporting each assignment, and include the required administrative actions.

shared_context.S1: The coordination cell will operate from 0600 to 1800 each day of the four-day field exercise.
shared_context.S2: The three desks are partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control; each desk must be staffed by a person with the applicable current qualification.
shared_context.S3: The available personnel for the three desks are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Carter has authority to publish the final staffing roster and tasking instructions.
shared_context.S5: The battalion's routine pre-exercise process is a qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff before the S-3 publishes the roster.
shared_context.S6: When publishing the roster, Maj. Carter records at least one administrative or tasking action for each desk assignment, such as updating the qualification record or attaching the supporting certification to the tasking order.
shared_context.S7: The final settlement format includes decisions, commitments, credited_facts, and justification_fact_ids; Maj. Carter must list every fact ID that informed an assignment in justification_fact_ids and list the corresponding administrative actions in commitments.

PF1.text: Sgt Malik is the only one of the three available personnel with a current host-nation language qualification, with a recorded proficiency score of exactly 92; 1st Lt. Nguyen confirmed the renewal and score in the personnel database this morning, but the updated qualification export is not yet on the S-3 briefing slide.

PF2.text: Cpl Ortiz is the only one of the three available personnel with current POL and hazardous-material accountability certification, and that certification is valid through exactly 2026-09-30; SFC Alvarez verified the certificate during the latest supply inspection, but the inspection update has not yet been entered in the roster tracker.

PF3.text: Spc Vega is the only one of the three available personnel with current movement-control-system operator certification, recorded at exactly the supervisor level; Lt. Brooks received the renewal notice and level from the system administrator today, but it has not yet been attached to the exercise tasking order.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt Malik must be assigned to the partner-liaison desk and the roster must record his host-nation language score as exactly 92.
Cpl Ortiz must be assigned to the POL-accountability desk and the roster must record the certification validity date as exactly 2026-09-30.
Spc Vega must be assigned to the movement-control desk and the roster must record the operator certification level as exactly supervisor.
The final roster must include at least three administrative or tasking actions covering the desk assignments or their qualification records.
The partner-liaison qualification fact must be cited by the decision-maker after being spoken aloud.

decisive_facts.why: Revealing PF1 changes the partner-liaison assignment to Sgt Malik and supplies the exact roster value of 92 for his language proficiency.
Revealing PF2 changes the POL-accountability assignment to Cpl Ortiz and supplies the exact certification-validity date of 2026-09-30.
Revealing PF3 changes the movement-control assignment to Spc Vega and supplies the exact certification level of supervisor.
